description: This Java class 'NotifyingController' is an Android Activity that manages starting and stopping a service called 'NotifyingService'. It sets up button click listeners that trigger service control actions, and inflates layout resources to define its UI.

classes.name: NotifyingController
classes.description: An Android Activity that provides UI controls to start and stop the 'NotifyingService' service, updating a notification periodically.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and assigns click listeners to start and stop buttons.

methods.name: mStartListener
methods.description: OnClickListener implementation that starts the NotifyingService when the start button is clicked.

methods.name: mStopListener
methods.description: OnClickListener implementation that stops the NotifyingService when the stop button is clicked.
